title: AI model catalog
lead: A list of AI models with prices per 1M tokens from three sources. Search, filter, sort, and estimate monthly cost. The data is a daily copy of my catalog sheet, refreshed every morning around 10:00 (WIB).
stale: The data is older than 36 hours; the daily refresh may be delayed.
staleSource: The sheet could not be read during the last refresh, so this is the previous data.
noData: No data yet. The first daily refresh has not run.
loadError: The model list could not be loaded. Try reloading the page.
noScript: This page needs JavaScript to filter and sort the model list.
calcNote: Cost = input price × input tokens + output price × output tokens, per source. Cost columns appear in the table and can be sorted.
note: Prices are USD per 1M tokens unless switched to IDR. 3:1 blend = three parts input and one part output. Prices are a daily copy, not live prices, and some come from manual pastes; check the provider's official page before relying on them.
